# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

Diagnosis inspects one category’s actual trained HSTU network (`view.model`). The supplied configuration describes absolute positional embeddings, causal attention, SiLU gates and residual FFNs; model implementation is not included here. `log2feats(sequence)` produces per-position features. Temporal probes call `final_features(features, sequence)` for the greatest nonpadding position in left-padded histories, then `predict_score` for candidate logits, including the trained lexical residual.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` receives the network, item embeddings, public training histories and metadata interfaces. `run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` consumes at most ten `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` batches of B × L tensors. It temporarily evaluates the network without gradients and restores module modes and random states afterward.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding cosine:** Samples up to 2,048 item ID embeddings, excludes reserved tokens, and reports `(mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2`. Higher values indicate greater directional alignment; this does not measure effective rank or relevance.
- **Training margins:** Scores positives minus negatives at valid positions. Reports mean, 10th percentile, negative-beats-positive rate and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower error rates indicate stronger sampled training separation, subject to score scale and sampling.
- **History sensitivity:** Samples up to 100 eligible users, holding out each training history’s final event as an in-sample target. Uses that target plus 99 unique negatives excluded from the user’s entire training history. Records target rank, HR@10, pairwise wins and ties.

# Perturbation & Tests

Tests identity/no-op, recent/oldest/random 20% deletion, final-item deletion, older-item shuffle and full shuffle. Histories are truncated once, compacted and left-padded without backfill. Stochastic interventions use five seeds. Paired effects report changes in HR@10/rank and top-10 overlap, with history-length strata and 10,000 user-bootstrap confidence intervals. Negative HR changes or positive rank changes indicate degradation. Failed score/ranking controls and nonfinite users are excluded.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

The returned object contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`; a JSON artifact is saved under `working/diagnostics`. Metrics include configuration, cosine, margins/counts, sensitivity effects, individual records, exclusions and cost.

Unavailable category breakdowns, validation effects, four-category macro effects and full-catalog stability are explicitly null. Timestamp effects and unavailable attributes are untested. Results describe in-sample behavior, not causal preferences or validation gains. Candidate overlap measures ranking stability, not catalog diversity. No additional model is fitted or fused.
